findings.evidenceJa: もうこの教会に用はない
findings.governingReading: We have no further business at this church
findings.explanation: Rin’s collective decision to leave becomes a dismissal directed only at Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: たまらずに振り返った
findings.governingReading: cannot help whipping around
findings.explanation: The involuntary bodily force of Shirou’s aversion to Kirei is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 足は勝手に後ずさる
findings.governingReading: my feet retreat on their own
findings.explanation: Shirou’s body recoiling independently becomes deliberate movement.

findings.highlight: a superhero requires a villain to defeat
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方には、倒すべき悪が必要だ
findings.governingReading: an ally of justice needs an evil to defeat
findings.explanation: The translation replaces Shirou’s defining ethical ideal with American superhero genre language during Kirei’s diagnosis of it.

findings.evidenceJa: 目の前が、真っ暗になりそう、だった
findings.governingReading: it felt as though everything before his eyes was about to go black
findings.explanation: An impending physical or psychological blackout becomes an already completed visual change.

findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも不安定なその願望
findings.governingReading: that desire is far too unstable
findings.explanation: The instability and contradiction of Shirou’s desire is recast as insecurity, changing the psychological diagnosis.

findings.evidenceJa: 目指す理想が矛盾しているだけの話
findings.governingReading: the ideal he is striving toward is simply contradictory
findings.explanation: A single pursued ideal is fractured into plural “target ideals,” producing malformed English and blurring Shirou’s specific contradiction.

findings.highlight: Your worries are normal for a human being
findings.evidenceJa: 君の葛藤は、人間としてとても正しい
findings.governingReading: your inner conflict is entirely proper for a human being
findings.explanation: Kirei’s validation of Shirou’s moral conflict is weakened into generic worries and ordinary normality.

findings.evidenceJa: 愉しげに笑みをこぼす神父
findings.governingReading: the priest lets a delighted smile spill across his face
findings.explanation: Kirei’s pleasure in exposing Shirou’s contradiction disappears, flattening his provocation and cruelty.

findings.highlight: You are now at the point of kill or be killed
findings.evidenceJa: 君は殺し、殺される側の人間になった
findings.governingReading: you have become one of those who kill and are killed
findings.explanation: A lasting change in Shirou’s human position is reduced to a generic immediate dilemma.

findings.highlight: He says so as I quickly make my way out
findings.evidenceJa: 早足で立ち去る背中に、そんな言葉が投げかけられた
findings.governingReading: those words are hurled at his back as he strides quickly away
findings.explanation: The narration’s forceful image of Kirei throwing the warning at Shirou’s retreating back is flattened into neutral speech.
